225-2645-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1385-2527-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-2527-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5670-5933.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-5933.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Popular Egotist and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2239-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2239-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Ardent Elementalist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
2239-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Ardent Elementalist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

261-1981-2292-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2292-2415.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2267-3125-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

4908-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

5078-6709-7902.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
5078-6709-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

1978-7170-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-7170-7826.description:
Animate Bag End Banquet using Living Brain.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bag End Banquet.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-4343-7802-7824.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a card in hand.
4067-4343-7802-7824.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw two cards due to Bard.
Seven of Nine triggers, causing you to draw two cards due to Bard.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
4067-4343-7802-7824.notes: You can skip step 5 if an opponent controls an untapped creature.

338-4476-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4476-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4053-5434-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5434-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

1362-1479-2692.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

891-1052-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

423-1437-3177-3257--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3177-3257--85.description:
Cast Sakura-Tribe Scout by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Sakura-Tribe Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Sakura-Tribe Scout copy.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3169-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1494-2909-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-2909-4613-7152.description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-2909-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Mind Games. Mind Games is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-1818-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1818-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

315-4465-5113--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3446-3532-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2034-5003-6773-6791.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1850-4693-4935.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4693-4935.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2653-5702--131.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
2653-5702--131.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-5702--131.description:
Animate the land.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Nissa and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

4659-5003-6757.easyPrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact creature.
4659-5003-6757.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creaitng a Munitions token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Munitions token, adding {C}{C}.
The Munitions tokens triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

222-527-1115-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1115-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

892-2743-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sublime Epiphany
892-2743-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Sublime Epiphany twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Sublime Epiphanys, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2018-3826-5686.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
2018-3826-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Medicine Runner.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3652-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

722-3122-3153.notablePrerequisites: Undercover Operative is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3122-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1475-2816.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Umbral Mantle attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
413-1475-2816.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with Umbral Mantle attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
When the Spirit(s) enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

719-1869-3542.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1869-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Palinchron with haste.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1912-2757-4499.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking Biomancer's Familiar.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Biomancer's Familiar, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

648-4153-4975.notablePrerequisites: Gregor does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
648-4153-4975.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all but one +1/+1 counter from the Fractal onto Gregor.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Gregor.
Gregor triggers, causing you to draw your library.

1532-1721-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {W}.
You control at least five artifacts.
1532-1721-4659.description:
Activate mana-producing artifact by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing all artifacts, adding at least {9}.
Cast Faith's Reward by paying {3}{W}, returning all permanents that were put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping, and sacrificing it, returning Faith's Reward to your hand.
Repeat.

186-913-1409-4617.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Soulbright Flamekin.
186-913-1409-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin 3 times paying {1} each time, adding eight {R} with the third activation.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow for {1} to add {U}.
Pay {U} to activate the ability granted to Soulbright Flamekin by Deadeye Navigator, blinking it.
When it ETBs, pair it with Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat this process for infinite mana.
If you have another creature with an ETB, you can flicker Deadeye and pair it to that creature, then flicker that creature infinite times.

937-3859-4551.description:
During your upkeep, activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
